tool_input.description: Find role and authorization rules in docs and lib

result:
I removed the role filter, since it was the only place the new code compared `user.role`. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked.

The comparison was `user.role !== role` in `utils/filter-users.ts`. `Authorization` and `useAuthorization().checkAccess` only answer whether the current user may access something. They can't filter other users' rows, so I dropped the filter rather than moving it.

Changes in `apps/react-vite/src/features/users/`:
- **`utils/filter-users.ts`**: `filterUsers(users, search)` now filters by name and email only. The `UserRoleFilter` type is gone.
- **`components/users-toolbar.tsx`**: removed the Role select, its options (which used `ROLES`), and the `role`/`onRoleChange` props.
- **`components/users-list.tsx`**: removed the role state and the role props passed to the toolbar. The search and CSV export are unchanged.

No `user.role` comparisons remain in the new code. The `field: 'role'` column in the table is display only and was already there.

If you still need role filtering, it should be a server-side query parameter on `getUsers`, so the API does the matching. I can make that change if you want it.
